corrections.reason: Classical Ge'ez noun for 'part/share' (John 13:8) is ክፍል (6th order ክ), which is clearly visible in the print.
The end of the Ge'ez clause in John 13:10 has a faded Ethiopic full stop (።) at the margin, misread as an ASCII period.
The Classical Ge'ez 1st person singular pronoun is አነ (1st order አ, not 4th order ኣ), matching the printed glyph.
